## Samsung foldables gain strong traction in Southeast Asia and Oceania

Strong foldable demand in SE Asia signals Samsung is successfully broadening the addressable premium-Android pool beyond mature markets — a supporting data point for the broader handset upgrade cycle and for component suppliers with Samsung MX exposure.

- Samsung's latest foldable lineup is seeing strong sell-through across Southeast Asian and Oceanian markets.
- Coverage characterizes demand positively, suggesting the premium Android foldable cycle is extending into emerging geographies.
- No specific unit volumes or market-share figures are disclosed.
- Positive read on Samsung's ability to sustain premium ASPs beyond core developed markets.
